consequence.statement: A new optional Helm value is available for setting custom environment variables in the webhook Pod. Operators do not have to do anything.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 adds a new Helm value, webhook.extraEnv, for setting custom environment variables in the webhook Pod. The same change also adds cainjector.extraEnv and startupapicheck.extraEnv.
